title: Grateful Dead Live at Crystal Ballroom on 1968-02-02

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a high‑energy Anthem era show featuring a smoking Cryptical / Other One and soaring Jerry Garcia guitar
ai_review.review: The tape captures an outstanding February ’68 Anthem‑era performance with tight, musical playing and a high‑octane Cryptical / Other One that even includes a rare Clementine jam. Reviewers praise the soundboard source as clear and give the show a full five‑star rating despite some uncertainty about whether it’s the complete 2/2 concert or a compiled collection.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed review gives a perfect 5‑star rating, highlighting both superb musical performance and good soundboard quality; limited sample size lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No complaints about clarity or mix; reviewers imply a clean, crisp capture typical of sbd sources.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Possibly a compiled set (Clementine > New Potato edit), but the performance remains tight and musical throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Soars on guitar after his first verse of vocals; highlighted for energetic playing.
